programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Tanssin pääkaupunki. On Amsterdam Dance Eventin aika, eli maailman suurimman elektronisen musiikin festivaalin, joka tuo 500 000 tanssin harrastajaa kaupunkiin. Yökonduktööri Errol kulkee erityisen DJ-junan kyydissä, kun taas turvallisuusosaston työntekijöillä Mennolla ja Baranilla on kiire huolehtia häiriköstä, joka on päihteiden vaikutuksen alaisena. Alankomaat 2025

programme.title: Pohjoisen valtatien pelastajat: kaaosta valtateillä!
programme.desc: Kekseliäät pelastustoimet. Nopea ajattelu ja kekseliäisyys auttavat hinausautonkuljettajia. Thord ja Torbjoern pyytävät ystävää siirtämään hiekka-auton nosturilla. Jo Roger ja Stig raivaavat toisen hylyn matkalla päätehtäväänsä, joka on täysi glyseriinisäiliöauto. Onneksi läheiseltä rakennustyömaalta löytyy lisää vetovoimaa kaivinkoneen muodossa. Ja Bjoern melkein uhraa varusteensa pelastaakseen maanviljelijän traktorin. Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc! Compilation - Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Autojen ensiapu
programme.desc: Cosworth kriisissä. Ford Cosworth oli aikoinaan laatuauto, mutta se muistuttaa Darrenia perhetragediasta. Pystyvätkö pojat entisöimään sen entiseen loistoonsa? National Geographic Channel Car SOS - Iso-Britannia 2012

programme.title: Pompeji: Oppaana Tom Hiddleston
programme.desc: Purkaus. Vesuviuksen purkautuessa Tom Hiddleston pohtii, kuka pakenee kaaosta ja kuka ottaa ohjat käsiinsä. Hän seuraa äitiään pelastamaan rientävää Avianusta ja taloaan suojelevaa Julia Felixiä. Lisäksi hän löytää Herculaneumista salaperäisen pretoriaanikaartilaisen. Onko tämä sivustakatsoja vai johtaja? Pimeyden laskeutuessa ja ensimmäisen tappavan vaiheen iskiessä Tom selvittää, voiko kukaan enää selvitä hengissä. Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston - Iso-Britannia 2025

programme.title: Suurten pyramidien kadonneet haudat
programme.desc: Pyramidien varjossa huippuarkeologien ryhmä aloittaa hämmästyttävät kaivaukset. Voisiko tämä salainen sijainti paljastaa aivan uusia todisteita nämä majesteettiset monumentit rakentaneista faaraoista? Voisiko faarao Khafren nimellä koristettu kivi ratkaista erään arkeologian suuren mysteerin eli sen, mitä tapahtui pyramideja rakennuttaneiden faaraoiden ruumiille. Lost Tombs of the Pyramids - Iso-Britannia 2020

programme.title: Pohjoisen valtatien pelastajat
programme.desc: Parempia yhdessä. Paikallinen hinausyrittäjä pyytää Thordia auttamaan traktorin pelastamisessa. Kun he sitten alkavat vetää, hinausauto liukuu jäällä ja uhkaa liittyä traktorin seuraksi puroon. Raido ja Rørvikin miehistö yrittävät pelastaa Overhallassa rekan ja perävaunun, jotka ovat törmänneet kallionseinämään. Heillä on kovat paineet, kun yksikin väärä liike voi repiä perävaunun kappaleiksi. Ice Road Rescue - Norja 2026

programme.title: Antoni Porowski: Elämänmakuiset reseptit
programme.desc: James Marsdenin saksalainen annos. Selvittäessään Marsdenin suvun rakkaan kanaruoan alkuperää Antoni vie Jamesin Texasin tasangoilta Saksaan, missä he huomaavat, kuinka paljon Jamesin suvun historiaa on muokannut hänen saksalaisten esi-isiensä kokemukset. Syödessään kuninkaallisten kanssa ja kiipeillessään Baijerin Alpeilla heille selviää salaisuuksia Jamesin esi-isien päätöksestä muuttaa maasta. No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski - Yhdysvallat 2024

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Tässä jaksossa Polin perhe hyvästelee rakkaan Kidinsä. Kid on ollut perheen jäsen jo vuosien ajan. Se on asunut viime aikoina Charlesin ja Bethin luona. Jaksossa nähdään silti monia hauskoja ja iskeviä hetkiä. Siinä vierailee myös muutama eksoottinen eläin aina Etelä-Michiganista asti. Oikein! Luvassa on kameleita. The Incredible Dr. Pol - Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Painepiste. Vain hetki lähdön jälkeen Japan Airlinesin lento 123 kokee kaksi räjähdystä. Lentäjällä on vaikeuksia pitää vahingoittunut Boeing 747 ilmassa. Se syöksyy vuoreen. Onnettomuudesta tulee yksi ilmailun historian eniten kuolemaa kylväneistä onnettomuuksista. Tutkijat epäilevät heti terrorismia, mutta jäänteet kertovat eri tarinan, mikä uhkaa kaikkia 747-koneita ympäri maailmaa. Air Crash Investigation - Kanada 2021

programme.title: Meret ilman vettä
programme.desc: Meksikonlahti. Meksikonlahden tyhjentäminen näyttää, että Amerikan tarinan voi nähdä katsomalla mitä aaltojen alta paljastuu kaupankäynnistä, orjuudesta ja sodista. Drain the Oceans - Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Meret ilman vettä
programme.desc: Uskomattomat sotalaivat. Skagerrakin taistelu vuonna 1916 oli historian karmein meritaistelu. Meriarkeologit ja historioitsijat ryhtyvät selvittämään sen salaisuuksia. Drain the Oceans - Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Katastrofitutkinta
programme.desc: Titan-ohjus, Estonia, Piper Alpha. Kolme katastrofia, jotka on analysoitu ja luotu uudelleen yksityiskohtaisesti asiantuntijoiden analyysin ja todisteiden avulla. Miten Titan II -ydinohjus räjähti Arkansasin siilossaan? Mikä virhe teki Estonia-aluksen uppoamisesta Euroopan pahimman merionnettomuuden sitten Titanicin? Räjähdys Piper Alphalla on historian tappavin onnettomuus öljynporauslautalla. Mikä aiheutti lautan räjähdyksen? Disaster Autopsy - Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.title: Katastrofitutkinta
programme.desc: Columbia, Eschede-juna, Grenfell Tower. Kolme katastrofia, jotka on analysoitu ja luotu uudelleen yksityiskohtaisesti asiantuntijoiden analyysin ja todisteiden avulla. Miten Columbian sukkula repeytyi palasiksi laskeutumisen aikana? Miksi niin monet kuolivat historian pahimmassa suurnopeusjunaturmassa Eschedessä Saksassa? Miten Lontoossa sijaitsevasta Grenfell Tower -nimisestä tornitalosta tuli 72 kuolonuhria vaatinut tulipalo? Disaster Autopsy - Yhdysvallat 2023

programme.desc: Onnettomuus Grand Canyonilla. Kaksi konetta syöksyi yhteentörmäyksen jälkeen Grand Canyoniin. Turmatutkijat löysivät koko lentojärjestelmää uhkaavan ongelman. Air Crash Investigation - Kanada 2011

Sen omistaja on Shaun, joka omistaa elämänsä yhteisön pelastuspalvelulle, ja lahon vaivaama Defender vaatii mittavia mekaanisia korjauksia. Pystyykö Autojen ensiapu palauttamaan tämän etulinjan sankarin takaisin palvelukseen? Car SOS - Iso-Britannia 2025

programme.title: Hirviöt: Totuus myyttien takana
programme.desc: Demonit. Ihmiskunta on uskonut demoneihin vuosisatojen ajan. Niiden juuret ulottuvat antiikkiin ja varahaiskirkon aikaan, mutta yksi erikoisimmista joukkoriivaustapauksista koettiin eräässä luostarissa 1600-luvun Ranskassa. Viktoriaanisella ajalla puolestaan kaksi sisarusta nousi maineeseen henkien välittäjänä. 1900-luvulla manaamisesta tuli menestys elokuvissa, ja niin sanottu ”saatanapaniikki” ruokki laajalle levinneitä salaliittoteorioita. Monsters: Truth Behind the Myths - Kanada 2026

programme.desc: Kaivostyöläisten toinen kuukausi maan alla alkaa, ja pinnalla keskitytään mahdottomalta tuntuvaan tehtävään: kaikkien 33 on päästävä turvallisesti kotiin. Pelastusoperaatio on kriittisessä vaiheessa, kun työläiset valmistautuvat nousemaan yksi kerrallaan pintaan ahtaassa kapselissa petollisen porausreiän läpi. programme.desc: Rocky-koira ja vintagemailat. Lentoaseman löytötavaraosaston työntekijät palauttavat matkustajille koiran, joka karkasi hihnasta saapuessaan lentokentälle ja vaelsi lentokentän alueella viikon ajan. Lisäksi omistajilleen palautetaan muun muassa ammattitennispelaajan vintagemailat, reppu täynnä elintärkeitä reseptilääkkeitä, lapsen rakastama pandapehmolelu ja kokonainen armeijan univormu. programme.desc: Havaijin saaren Ono. Gordon matkustaa Havaijin Isolle saarelle etsimään raaka-aineita, jotka ovat ono eli herkullisia. Hän kulkee tulivuoren rinteillä, trooppisissa sademetsissä ja meren aallokossa metsästäen, etsien ja kalastaen löytääkseen saaren aidot maut. Gordon kohtaa keittiömestari Makani Carzinon, mutta pystyykö hän hyödyntämään parhaiten Havaijin kulinaarisia aarteita ja voittamaan paikalliset puolelleen? Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted - Iso-Britannia 2023

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Norjalainen painajainen. Hetki Widerøen lennon 839 nousun jälkeen lentäjät joutuivat kamppailemaan pitääkseen koneen suorassa. Vain 65 sekuntia lähdön jälkeen kone syöksyi Pohjois-Atlanttiin, ja kaikki koneessa olleet menehtyivät. Tutkijat löysivät vaurioita ohjauskomponentista. Kun he saivat tietää, että toinen Widerøe-lento melkein koki saman kohtalon, he analysoivat päätöksiä, jotka vaaransivat ihmishenkiä. Air Crash Investigation - Kanada 2025

Hänen vaimonsa, Jeannetta, ja ystävänsä, Andy, toivovat, että Autojen ensiapu voisi herättää vanhan klassikon henkiin. Mutta onko auto jo liian vaurioitunut? Car SOS - Iso-Britannia 2021

programme.title: Sydneyn lentokentällä

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Dirty (2006)
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn star as the legendary lovers Robin Hood and Maid Marion, who reunite twenty years after their first meeting. Now the mother superior of a nunnery, Marion finds herselfdrawn to a somewhat less agile Robin Hood when he returns from a lengthy Crusade in the Holy Lands.

programme.title: Sheena (1984)
programme.desc: Exotic Tanya Roberts stars as Sheena, a comic book legend that comes to life. As a child, she was lost in the African jungle and adopted by the Zambouli tribe. She rules over the untamed wilds of Africa, until outsiders challenge her domain in this exotic action-adventure.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: And Justice For All
programme.desc: Al Pacino portrays a hot-shot lawyer looking for justice in a justice system run amok.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions 2
programme.desc: School's never been more captivating -- or challenging -- than when a pair of unscrupulous siblingsset out to teach each other a lesson in this provocative textbook on deception, temptation and revenge. The prequel to Cruel Intentions.

programme.title: Diabolique (1996)
programme.desc: The wife and mistress of the sadistic dean of an exclusive prep school conspire to murder him.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: In this made-for-TV movie, two brothers who battled on opposing sides of the Civil War return home at the end of the war to discover that their family has been kidnapped by Confederate forces.

programme.title: Return To The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: Two children grow up on a deserted island unencumbered by civilization.

programme.title: Lawrence Of Arabia
programme.desc: Winner of seven Academy Awards(r), including Best Picture (1962), this is the restored director's cut of the breathtaking masterpiece.

programme.title: Close Encounters Of The Third Kind (Director's Cut)
programme.desc: We are not alone... A line worker, after an encounter with UFO's, feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Four drifters arrive in a small frontier town and become unlikely heroes in a battle against a powerful family and a corrupt sheriff.

programme.title: 8 Million Ways To Die
programme.desc: Trying to help a Los Angeles prostitute, an alcholoic ex-cop runs up against her vicious Colombian drug dealer boyfriend.

programme.title: Sniper (1993)
programme.desc: Tom Berenger is a bush-savvy Marine who teams with a political marksman (Billy Zane) to eliminate a Colombian drug lord in the jungles of Central America.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes (2000)
programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

programme.title: The Man Who Loved Women (1983)
programme.desc: In Blake Edwards' all-star romantic comedy, Burt Reynolds is David, a sculptor who is an incurable womanizer, who never met a woman he didn't love. He pays a visit to a psychiatrist, Marianna (Julie Andrews), in the hope of removing a creative block he's been experiencing; instead, he falls for her and she for him.

programme.title: The Lobster
programme.desc: A love story set in a dystopian near future where single people are arrested and transferred to a creepy hotel. There they are obliged to find a matching mate in 45 days. If they fail, they are transformed into an animal and released into the woods.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: Commencement ceremony is over, it's time for Huntington High's graduation party as jocks, geeks, prom queens, and misfits alike make a statement about the past and plot the uncertain future in this raucous comedy.

programme.title: The Wedding Planner
programme.desc: A wedding planner finally meets "Mr. Right", but he's the groom from one of her upcoming weddings.

programme.title: Rough Night
programme.desc: Five friends get a beach house in Miami for a wild bachelorette weekend that goes completely off the rails.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: When it comes to romance, Patrick Dempsey delivers in this madcap comedy. Working his way through college as a pizza delivery boy, Dempsey learns a few lessons in love from bored housewives who are looking for more than anchovies on their pizza.

And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Alleging that Vanden Pharmaceuticals' antidepressant Aprox caused his client Sheila Reese to miscarry, celebrity trial lawyer Lawrence Brand arranges for Jane to help in his lawsuit. When Brand shows up late for the first day of the trial, Jane is on her own after Vanden's lawyers reveal that Sheila had been taking a dangerous painkiller while she was pregnant. And after she can't find documents that Brand claims are in the case file, Jane worries about his mental state when he becomes disoriented during his courtroom presentation. Meanwhile, Jane hesitates to tell Stacy that she'll be moving out once she and Owen find a house. Enlisting Grayson's help when Jonah Pierce claims he owns the patent on the pake, Stacy realizes that the one person who can back up her story is her ex-business partner and con artist Nikki LePree. Finding her in jail under another name, Grayson offers to keep Nikki's identity a secret in exchange for photos that prove Stacy invented the pake. But when they fail to convince the judge, Stacy and Grayson challenge Jonah to a bake-off to establish who's telling the truth. Meanwhile, when Luke decides to advance his relationship with Kim, he's surprised when she suddenly claims that she doesn't want to see him anymore. Tracking down Brand's ex-wife, Jane learns that he has a degenerative brain condition known as Pick's disease. When confronted with the truth, Brand agrees to let Jane take the lead in the lawsuit, but not before falsely claiming he has proof that Vanden knew about the dangers of Aprox. So with Owen's encouragement, Jane makes it appear as though she actually has the study's results, forcing a Vanden executive to freeze up on the witness stand. And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: Upon returning to work following Gina Blunt's arrest, Jane and Grayson are representing Kathy Kelton, who is suing her late fiancé Scott Richards' stepmother Caitlin over custody of his cremated remains. Though the case looks weak after Scott's sister testifies that Kathy is eating her fiancé's ashes, a sympathetic Grayson presses Jane to continue. Meanwhile, when Parker reveals that he secretly allowed the FBI to use the firm to nab Gina, Kim is angry over being kept in the dark about the sting. And as Jane starts to accept that Owen's sudden disappearance means that he's left her for another woman, she's surprised when he suddenly returns. When Kathy says that eating his ashes allows her to see Scott's ghost, Jane wonders if she would be better off getting psychological rather than legal help. But after Kathy collapses in the courtroom, she's found to be suffering from heavy metal poisoning. After tests indicate that Kathy was poisoned by a deadly chemical she ingested by eating Scott's remains, Grayson suspects that Caitlin used the substance to murder her stepson in order to inherit the $20 million he was about to receive from his father's estate. When he finally convinces Jane to listen to what he has to say, Owen explains his disappearance by revealing that he was getting checked out at the Mayo Clinic when he had a heart attack that left him in a coma for weeks. But while Jane wants to pick up where they left off, concerns about his health cause Owen to withdraw his marriage proposal. After Teri is declared the winner of a song contest, she asks Luke for a loan to finance a recording. When he looks into the record company, however, Luke discovers that Teri is the target of a con man. And when Luke takes her to a performance given by another of the contest winners, Teri learns the truth about the con. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Freddie the Fox" Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous "Light of Arabia" diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris stalk the sands of Malibu Beach to track down the surfside killer of several young women in "Sandcastles Murders." Police have virtually no leads in their investigation of the "Sandcastle Murders." When one of the victims turns out to be a personal friend of Kris, boss Charlie give the girls permission to handle their own investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Stunned by the mysterious death of his favorite folk-rock singer, Charlie sends Kelly, Kris and Sabrina to find everyone who spent time with the victim the night she pied in "Angel Blues." Amy Waters is one of the most popular singers in the country. Shortly after freaking out during a concert performance, Amy calls her dad to say she's coming home by cab to "get straight." But Amy makes a few stops along the way. One of the last people to see her alive is Lenny, the taxi driver Kris becomes acquainted with during the investigation. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.sub-title: Mother Goose Is Running For His Life
programme.desc: Leland Swinnerton, 70-year-old president of a huge toy corporation, is known to everyone as Mother Goose. He goes to Charlie's Angels for assistance when someone tries to sabotage the company toys by blowing up the corporate offices, causing at least one death. Sabrina, posing as a secretary from Hong Kong, becomes friendly with Gordon Roclair, the brilliant but crazy design director. Roclair confides to Sabrina that he hates Mother Goose, and is working for Tony Phelan, a gangster with plans to gain control of the company. With Sabrina tagging along as "partner," Roclair installs secret microphones around the factory, so that Phelan can hear all the latest corporate decisions. It is a simple matter for the Angels to sabotage the saboteurs by changing the location of the microphones. Instead of picking up important conversations in Mother Goose's office, Phelan hears the secretary talking about her flowers. By planing a microphone of their own in Phelan's truck, the Angels pick up all the wire tap communications and hear the gangsters' plans. This mike is especially useful when Phelan's accomplice, Orwell, discovers the identity of Kelly, who had been working with him as a "bugging expert." Orwell forces Kelly at gunpoint to drive the truck into the country, but Bosley and Kris are right behind, listening to every word. In the end, Roclair and Phelan are completely confused. Roclair finds Mother Goose's secret plans for the new Christmas toys with Sabrina's help, but Kris switches them for a set of useless vacuum cleaner blueprints. Phelan and his hoods chase Roclair, believing he doublecrossed them. In the confusion, a booby--trapped toy cannon in the factory shoots at Roclair and he falls, only from fright, because Kris had stopped up the barrel with bubblegum. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their in

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When two blonde "call girls" are brutally murdered in Mrs. Dolly Smith's apartment building, Kelly and Kris reluctantly go undercover as prostitutes and move into Mrs. Smith's establishment. On their first day at work, the trio arouses suspicion with their clever tactics to avoid meeting with "customers." But the Angels are more interested in the Italian restaurant across the street, where Freddie, the macho delivery boy works. He brings pizza to the girls in the building almost every day, and always acts aggressive and threatening. Then Bonnie, another blond girl, is attacked but manages to escape. When she says her assailant smelled like a restaurant, it looks like Freddie is the man. Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie uses the Angels plus his own priceless collection of jade as bait to trip up an acrobatic jewel thief and a killer in "THE JADE TRAP." Gigolo Denny Railsback murders wealthy Julie Redmond when she becomes disenchanted. As Denny is doing away with Julie in the living room, cat burglar Ted Machlin is in the bedroom stealing jewels. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. The setting is a posh residential hotel into which Kelly checks as a lonely heiress, Kris as a Swedish movie star and Bosley as a flamboyant auctioneer. Sabrina does her sleuthing as a hotel employee. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie; an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David-Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie uses the Angels plus his own priceless collection of jade as bait to trip up an acrobatic jewel thief and a killer in "THE JADE TRAP." Gigolo Denny Railsback murders wealthy Julie Redmond when she becomes disenchanted. As Denny is doing away with Julie in the living room, cat burglar Ted Machlin is in the bedroom stealing jewels. When Denny spots Ted, he makes it appear that the jewel thief is the murderer. The setting is a posh residential hotel into which Kelly checks as a lonely heiress, Kris as a Swedish movie star and Bosley as a flamboyant auctioneer. Sabrina does her sleuthing as a hotel employee. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie; an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David-Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Freddie the Fox" Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous "Light of Arabia" diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Rakkauden perässä maalle
programme.desc: Neljä kaupunkilaista päättää muuttaa kaukokumppaniensa luo nähdäkseen, että selviääkö heidän suhteensa kaukana Yhdysvaltojen syrjäisissä kolkissa. Yhdysvallat 2024

programme.title: Karkkikuningatar
programme.desc: Cadillac Wedding and Rainbow Fiesta. Tapahtumajärjestäjä Jackie Sorkin tiimeineen toteuttaa asiakkaidensa villeimmätkin visiot karamelleista! Hollywoodin karkkikuningattarena tunnetun naisen osaavissa käsissä herkut taipuvat aina perinteisestä makeispuffetista syötävään syntymäpäivämekkoon. Yhdysvallat 2011

programme.title: Kakkukuningas
programme.desc: Kakkukuningas-sarjan nokkamies Buddy Valastro luotsaa kilpailua, jossa kondiittorit kisaavat kakunvalmistus ja -koristelutaidoissa. Jokaisessa jaksossa tippuu yksi pelistä pois, kunnes taitavin kakkutaikuri on selvillä. Yhdysvallat 2009

programme.title: 90 päivää morsiamena
programme.desc: Thomas ja Paula riitaantuvat ennen häitä, Ashia ei välitä ystäviensä epäilyistä, ja Josh tarvitsee vastauksia ennen kuin astuu alttarille. Yhdysvallat 2025

programme.title: Satakiloiset kämppäkaverit

programme.title: Satakiloiset siskot
programme.desc: Amy ja Tammy ajokortin hankkiminen alkaa huonosti. Chris ja Brittany saavat odottamattomia uutisia. Tammy ei ole valmis antamaan anteeksi Mistylle. Yhdysvallat 2026

programme.title: Tuhatkiloinen perhe
programme.desc: The Big Reveal. Lihavuudesta kärsivä perhe taistelee laihduttamisen parissa. Hän on valmis laittamaan oman elämänsä vaakalaudalle, jotta saisi muunkin perheen pudottamaan painoaan. Yhdysvallat 2018

programme.title: Tohtori Paise
programme.desc: Popping Popeye. Tohtori Sandra Lee, eli Dr. Pimple Popper, on tunnettu ihotauti- ja kauneuskirurgi, joka hoitaa potilaidensa erilaisia ihosairauksia auttaakseen heitä saamaan elämänsä takaisin. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Apua, mikä tauti!
programme.desc: Dad With No Limbs. Apua, mikä tauti! vie matkalle ympäri maailmaa erikoisten ihmiskohtaloiden pariin. Sarja pureutuu verta itkevän naisen, jättimäisestä kasvojen kasvaimesta kärsivän miehen ja muiden äärimmäisen harvinaisia oireyhtymiä potevien ihmisten tarinoihin. Lääketiede ei pysty parantamaan heitä, mutta he eivät myöskään anna sairauden estää itseään elämästä täysillä. Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Pahuuden Varjo
programme.desc: Mutanttininjakilppareiden yrittäessä houkutella paroni Draxum esiin Tikku on kiireinen selvittäessään Aprilin uuden työpaikan omituisia tapahtumia.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Portaalikaappaus! / Warren ja Hypno Yhteen Sopii
programme.sub-title: Portaalikaappaus! / Warren ja Hypno Yhteen Sopii
programme.desc: Leo hukkaa veljensä portaaliin ja joutuu matkustamaan mystiseen Salakaupunkiin pelastaakseen heidät. // Kaikki tahtovat sitä, mitä Warren Stonella on, mutta hän ei siitä luovu taistelutta ja joutumatta petetyksi.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Operaatio: Normaali / Sparrauspari
programme.desc: Leo ja Donnie pyrkivät epätoivoisesti auttamaan Aprilia nauttimaan leppoisasta päivästä uuden ystävän kanssa. // Raph ystävystyy uuden sparrausparin kanssa ja joutuu salaamaan asian veljiltään, jotka eivät pitäisi hänestä.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI

programme.desc: Auttaessaan Peruspitsan omistajaa, señor Huesoa, veljellinen kilpailuhenkisyys saa Leon ja Mikeyn harhautumaan sivuraiteille. // Paroni Draxum näkee vaivaa noustakseen Jalkaklaanin arvoasteikossa.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Mystinen Kirjasto / Lila Peli
programme.desc: Kilpikonnat tonkivat mystisen kirjaston kolkkia etsiessään tapaa pelastaa Mylläkän. // Uusi kilpailuhenkinen videopeli on vallannut New Yorkin ja Donnie tekisi mitä tahansa päästäkseen siinä ykkössijalle.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Konna vastaan Viemäri / Mutanttijengi
programme.desc: Rento viemärikellunta muuttuu villiksi, kun Raphael joutuu eroon veljistään ja jää ypöyksin. // Kilpikonnat yrittävät tehdä hyvää mutta saavatkin koko New Yorkin raivon valtaan.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles FI: Rottamies ja Vauhdin Hurma / Ninjojen Ikiaikainen Kätkeytymistaito

programme.desc: Isien ja poikien yhteinen päivä saa Tikun ilmoittamaan tankin mukaan romuralliin. // Tikku on kovilla senseinä ja isänä, kun hän yrittää opettaa pojille ninjojen kätkeytymistaitoa.

programme.title: Lääkärit vastaan internet
programme.desc: 2/8. Mistä on kyse, jos sisäelimet ovat sijoittuneet vatsaonteloon peilikuvan tavoin? Entä mikä saa ihmisen äkkiä tuhoamaan kaikki kuvat puhelimestaan ilman syytä? Kuka tekee oikean diagnoosin? Norjalainen tietokilpailusarja, jossa toisistaan ottavat mittaa lääkärit ja tavalliset kansalaiset, joilla on apunaan internet.

programme.title: Äidiltä tyttärelle
programme.desc: Lindalla havaittiin rintasyöpä, kun hän oli 35-vuotias. Kolmen sukupolven naiset keskustelevat naisellisuudesta, naisellisesta ulkomuodosta sekä siitä, miksi niillä on väliä sairaanakin. (U) S02E03

programme.title: Hot rod -unelmaa
programme.desc: 4/6. Viikkojen työ menee hukkaan, kun auton runko pitää rakentaa kokonaan uusiksi. Samaan aikaan kori tuodaan paikalle ja lopputulos alkaa vihdoin näyttää oikealta hot rod -autolta. Tuotanto: SVT, 2021 (U)

programme.title: Efter Nio
programme.desc: Benjamin Ingrosso soittaa erikoisia soittimia, Julia Kuokkanen Neuvostokuplastaan, Emma Frans tekoälystä ja aivomädästä, Sami Kieksi vaikeasta lapsuudestaan, Katja Bargum hämähäkeistä. Parad Media.

programme.title: Minun totuuteni
programme.desc: 2/8. Kristian Luuk haastattelee näyttelijä Hedda Stiernstedtiä, joka kertoo teinivuosien harhailusta sekä rakkaussuhteessa kokemastaan väkivallasta. Eri roolien esittämisestä on tullut hänelle kuin huumetta. Mitä hän oikeastaan tarkoittaa sillä? (U)

programme.title: Rahaa, rahaa, rahaa
programme.desc: 2/4: Rahanpesu. Kuulemme jatkuvasti miljoonista, jotka katoavat jäljettömiin suurissa rahanpesuskandaaleissa. Vaan miten konnat oikeastaan tekevät sen? Ja kun kerran kansainvälisen rahanpesun arvo on huikeat 2 000 miljardia dollaria vuodessa, miksi me tavalliset ihmiset emme saa osaamme kakusta? (U)

programme.title: Kyläkanavan valtakunta
programme.desc: 1/6. Tuhkasta liekkeihin. Maalahden paikallistelevision tulisielut taistelevat kanavansa puolesta. Toimintaa uhkaavat kosteusvauriot, nuorten puute ja lakkauttaminen. Selviääkö Malax-TV?

programme.title: Kuningatar Ena
programme.desc: 6/6. Syvähaastattelu. Kuningasperhe on hajonnut ympäri Eurooppaa. Ena on palannut Lontooseen, jossa hän antaa haastattelun toimittaja Augusto Assíalle. Kenraali Franco ei katso sitä hyvällä. Toteutuuko Enan toive koskaan? (U)

programme.title: Historia: Cambridgen vakoojat
programme.desc: Miten Cambridgen yliopiston opiskelijatovereista tuli vakoojia, jotka toimivat Neuvostoliiton hyväksi 1930-60-luvuilla? Ohjelmassa seurataan ennen kaikkea Kim Philbyä, joka paljastettuaan pakeni Neuvostoliittoon, missä hän kuoli alkoholisoituneena vuonna 1988. (U)

programme.title: Funkiksen liekki
programme.desc: Kaisa Blomstedtin kulttuurihistoriallinen dokumentti suomalaisesta funktionalismista ja sen uudesta tulemisesta. T: Filmikonttori Oy, 1989. (U)

programme.title: Muistojeni Karjala
programme.desc: 7/10. Takaisin Karjalaan. Ensimmäisiä paluumuuttajia odotti kotiseudulla tuhottu maisema. Oman kodin näkeminen, vaikka jäljellä olivat vain rauniot, oli kuitenkin monen mielestä elämän ihanin hetki. (2004) (U)

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano
programme.desc: Kausi 5, 57/250. Valheita. Curron arvonimihakemuksesta nousee Leocadian ja Alonson välille riita. Ciro vaatii Manuelilta selitystä Julietan palkkauksen takia. Jännite Marían ja Carlon välillä kasvaa uuden valheen myötä. Leocadiallakin on paljastettavaa.

programme.title: Itse asiassa kuultuna: Hilkka Kinnunen
programme.desc: Operettiteatterin sielu ja primadonna Hilkka Kinnunen (1925-2026) säkenöi muistellessaan. Hän tiesi jo lapsena tulevansa esiintyväksi taiteilijaksi. Haastattelijana Hilla Blomberg. (2007)(U)

programme.title: Elävä arkisto: Maakalla
programme.desc: Perämerellä noin 16 kilometrin päässä Kalajoen kaupungin rantaviivasta sijaitsee kaksi saarta, joita hallitsevat kalastajat. Ruotsin kuninkaan v. 1771 säätämän lain mukaan Kallankarien asioista päättää karikokous. (2008)

programme.title: Pörriäinen lentää hämärissä
programme.desc: 7/8. Onnettomuudesta aiheutuu draamaa, ja ystävykset kuulevat järisyttäviä tietoja patsaasta. Annika ja David tuntevat aina vain suurempaa vetoa toisiaan kohtaan, ja Annika päättää uhmata kirousta. Julia toimittaa arvoituksellisen viestin - viimeisen vihjeen.

programme.title: Tyra-pennun seikkailut
programme.desc: Tyra suurkaupungissa. Pitkän automatkan jälkeen on vihdoin aika tassutella suurkaupungissa. Busseista ja raitiovaunuista lähtee kamalasti ääntä, ja ihmisiä kiiruhtaa joka suunnalla ohitse. Hetken kuluttua Tyra ei enää jaksa kävellä, mutta ohikulkijoita hän tervehtii silti mielellään. Kunhan vain hän saa olla sylissä. Jopa kahvila tulee Tyralle tutuksi. Suurkaupunki tarjoaa monenlaista koettavaa! Tuotanto: Flickorna Ab, 2024. S01E10

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 17.55
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: BUU-klubben
programme.desc: Tänään katsomme BUU-klubbenin päivän jakson, ja lisäksi BUU-kinossa esitetään sarjoja Kasper ja Petra sekä Fia ja keijut.

programme.title: Taviksesta kuninkaallinen
programme.desc: 2/3. Kuninkaalliset häät. Prinssi Williamin ja Kate Middletonin häät olivat maailman katsotuimmat sitten vuoden 1981. Moderni rakkaus uudistaa perinteitä ja muokkaa kuningasperheiden odotuksia. (U)

programme.title: Yle Nyheter TV-nytt 19.30
programme.desc: Viimeisimmät uutiset, uutisanalyysit ja reportaasit ruotsinkieliseltä rannikkoseudulta, muualta Suomesta ja maailmalta.

programme.title: Egenlandin matkakohteet
programme.desc: Tässä C.L. Engelin suunnittelemassa komeassa posti- ja tullitalossa toimii nykyään raikas ja moderni kulttuurikeskus.

programme.title: Màkari - Sisilian murhamysteerit
programme.desc: Kaunis kiusaus 1/2. Suleima on palannut komean pomonsa kanssa. Saverio suostuu vanhan ystävänsä tueksi mafianvastaisen järjestön konferenssiin, jossa tapahtuu murha. Pääsikö mafia sisäpiiriin? S02E03

programme.title: Historia: Elämää Hitlerin Saksassa
programme.desc: 1/4. Vallan ja pelon aika. Vuonna 1933 Hitler nousee valtaan ja Saksan arki muuttuu. Kansalaisten päiväkirjamerkinnät paljastavat innostuksen, pelon ja syrjinnän. Vallan kasvu, propagandakulkueet ja antisemitismi ravistelevat perheitä eri puolilla Saksaa.

programme.title: Toive-elokuva: Badding
programme.desc: Fiktiivinen elokuva todellisesta henkilöstä Rauli Badding Somerjoesta. O: Markku Pölönen. N: Janne Reinikainen, Peter Franzén, Karoliina Blackburn. (2000) (U).

programme.title: Uusi Kino: My name is hope
programme.desc: Lyhytelokuva sortajan ja sorretun välisestä ajattomasta kamppailusta aikana, jolloin unohtaminen on kuolettavin ase vapautta vastaan. O: Sherwan Haji. Tuotanto: Aalto-yliopisto/ELO (Suomi 2025).

programme.title: Uusi Kino: TJ28
programme.desc: Palestiinansuomalainen Amani Lillak suorittaa vapaaehtoista asepalvelustaan Suomen armeijan lääkintäjoukoissa. Kesken loppusotaharjoituksen hän saa kuulla isänsä kotimaassa eskaloituneesta kriisistä. O: Yasmin Najjar

programme.title: Uusi Kino: TJ28

programme.title: Lääkärit vastaan internet
programme.desc: 3/8. Mistä johtuu, jos pituuskasvu ei tuokaan mukanaan parrankasvua? Entä mikä voi olla syynä voimakkaisiin mutta vaikeasti määriteltäviin kipuihin? Kuka tekee oikean diagnoosin? Norjalainen tietokilpailusarja, jossa toisistaan ottavat mittaa lääkärit ja tavalliset kansalaiset, joilla on apunaan internet.

programme.title: Hot rod -unelmaa
programme.desc: 5/6. Kokenut autonrakentaja Roffe tulee vilkaisemaan Månsin aikaansaannoksia. Hän tekee muutamia huolestuttavia huomioita -autosta. Kesä on kohta käsillä eikä Måns ole vielä edes käynnistänyt moottoria. Tuotanto: SVT, 2021 (U)

programme.title: Sinkkumysteeri
programme.desc: 6/7. Pahinta mitä olen kokenut. Cesiliellä on edessään keskustelu, jota hän on pelännyt. Jonas rakastuu yllättäen. Palomies Tommy pohtii, ansaitseeko hän saada osakseen rakkautta. (U)

programme.title: Deittaavat daamit
programme.desc: Saanko pitää kädestä kiinni? Erja nappaa miehen mukaansa tuktuk-ajelulle. Camilla ja Iris pohtivat uusia mahdollisuuksia. Nina kertoo elämästään kaksoisleskenä. Annemarie miettii, voiko erosta päästä yli. (U) S02E03

programme.title: Minun totuuteni
programme.desc: 3/8. Kristian Luukin haastateltavana on näyttelijä Tomas von Brömssen, joka kertoo suuresta surusta, yllätysrakkaudesta sekä ainaisesta naurun tavoittelusta. Mutta miksi hänet nähdään aina altavastaajan roolissa? (U)

programme.title: Vanhan talon uusi elämä
programme.desc: Mikään ei ole vaaterissa. Marius ei ole vielä saanut ulkopuolta valmiiksi, mutta hän on silti päättänyt aloittaa sisätilojen työt. Se vie runsaasti aikaa, koska kaikki seinät ja katot pitää saada suoriksi. S02E05

programme.title: Sisustusarkkitehdin kotona
programme.desc: Osa 5/6. Carouschka Streijffert. Carouschka Streijffert on sisustusarkkitehti, taiteilija ja lavastaja. Hänellä on upea ullakkoasunto, josta aukeaa näkymä yli Tukholman Södermalmin. T: SVT, 2021. (U)

programme.title: Daphnen vanavedessä
programme.desc: Lasse Pöysti ja Ralf Långbacka purjehtivat Kreikan saaristossa purjelaiva Daphnen reittiä seuraillen. Matkalla he palauttavat mieleensä Göran Schildtin ajatuksia ja tapaavat hänet Leroksessa. (2000)(U)

programme.title: Näin Ruotsi rakennettiin
programme.desc: 8/8. Kylä - yksi kaikkien ja kaikki yhden puolesta. Onko kylä tulevaisuuden konsepti? Astrid Lindgrenin Melukylästä alkava tarina siirtää kylätunnelman uusiin naapurustokaupunginosiin, kuten Örebron Rostaan.

programme.title: Linnunratojen kansaa
programme.desc: Dokumentti miljoonien arktisten lintujen muutosta ohi Suomen rannikon ja niiden merkityksestä ihmiselle ennen ja nyt. Käsikirjoittaja ja ohjaaja Ville Suhonen (1995)(U)

programme.title: Muistojeni Karjala

programme.title: La Promesa - Salaisuuksien kartano
